{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = I'm thrilled.

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:30.840

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:33.319
    | text      = I know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:34.319
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:35.319

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:36.319
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:37.319
    | text      = And I will let you know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:38.319
    | text      = I'll give you a full report.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:39.319
    | text      = I'm excited though.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:40.319
    | text      = I expect nothing less and I fully expect you to be wearing them at our next recording.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:44.359
    | text      = You have set, you and your wife quite frankly, have set the bar incredibly high for these
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:48.920
    | text      = things though.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:49.920
    | text      = Like if, I don't know if they can live up to the hype.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:52.280
    | text      = If they don't deliver for you, that doesn't bother me because they delivered for me my
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:56.239
    | text      = friend.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:57.239
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:58.239
    | text      = And my experience can't take away from yours.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:01:59.239
    | text      = No it can't.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:00.239
    | text      = But hey, who knows.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:01.719
    | text      = I don't think I'm a sweatpants snob.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:04.480
    | text      = We'll find out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:05.480
    | text      = I'm hoping that you like them realistically just so I can then wear my pants to record
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:11.680
    | text      = to.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:12.680
    | text      = You can do that anyway.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:13.680
    | text      = Ah, no I can't.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:14.680
    | text      = You're welcome to.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:15.680
    | text      = No, no, no, no, you can't have one person in jeans and one person in sweatpants.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:18.000
    | text      = There's a very clear problem there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:19.580
    | text      = I think when they're you and I, yes you can.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:22.900
    | text      = Cause you're spiritually already in sweatpants.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:26.780
    | text      = And I should be wearing slacks or something.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:28.740
    | text      = You know like.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:29.740
    | text      = Sure, sure, sure, sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:30.740
    | text      = Every time before we start recording, sometimes I will not have shoes on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:34.860
    | text      = And I will put on shoes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:36.139
    | text      = Very Mr. Rogers style.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:37.740
    | text      = I don't feel like I can record the show in sandals or without shoes on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:43.780
    | text      = Same doesn't apply to you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:44.780
    | text      = I understand that, but you know when in Rome if we were recording in my place, we're both
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:50.460
    | text      = wearing sweatpants.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:51.460
    | text      = Or I'm wearing sweatpants at least.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:52.460
    | text      = But I'm coming in to you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:53.460
    | text      = I'm still wearing shoes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:54.460
    | text      = Yeah, well of course you are.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:55.460
    | text      = Even if I'm in your house.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:56.460
    | text      = Listen, you wear shoes in my house.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:02:58.460
    | text      = I wouldn't suggest not wearing shoes in my house.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:00.500
    | text      = Dogs all over the place.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:02.139
    | text      = Exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:03.139
    | text      = Well thank you and thank you to your wife.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:05.780
    | text      = Very sweet.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:06.780
    | text      = You are welcome and she was so excited to get them for you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:08.819
    | text      = That's wonderful.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:09.900
    | text      = So nice, so nice.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:10.900
    | text      = Yes, what's your bright spot?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:12.180
    | text      = Well Jordan, I realized that I had not a bright spot, but a dark spot.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:17.780
    | text      = And I'm pointing at you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:18.780
    | text      = I can feel it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:19.780
    | text      = See this?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:20.780
    | text      = I do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:21.780
    | text      = I sense it right now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:22.780
    | text      = Dark spot was me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:23.780
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:24.780
    | text      = And here's why.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:25.780
    | text      = We are the tat guys.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:26.780
    | text      = That's true.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:27.780
    | text      = That was our phone number for a while.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:29.860
    | text      = And I realized that I was not living up to my end of the bargain.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:33.460
    | text      = You were getting tats.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:34.460
    | text      = I was.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:35.460
    | text      = And I was not getting tats.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:36.460
    | text      = You were not.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:37.460
    | text      = And so I decided to rectify that by getting a new tattoo.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:39.740
    | text      = Hell yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:40.740
    | text      = Hell yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:42.580
    | text      = This is the first tattoo that I've gotten that is exposed to when you're wearing short
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:49.139
    | text      = sleeve shirts.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:50.139
    | text      = The other things would be covered by that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:52.060
    | text      = So this is very vulnerable and public in a way that I cannot hide it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:58.219
    | text      = So it's a real new life.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:03:59.919
    | text      = It's a real new jump off point for me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:04.340
    | text      = It's an interesting feeling.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:05.340
    | text      = I bet.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:06.340
    | text      = Just have like, I can't hide this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:07.379
    | text      = My family, or my dad specifically, no tattoos.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:11.219
    | text      = I don't know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:12.580
    | text      = No tattoos.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:13.659
    | text      = So until I was maybe 26, all of my tattoos were coverable.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:20.180
    | text      = Every single one of them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:21.300
    | text      = They didn't know I had tattoos until a few years ago.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:26.100
    | text      = I love tattoos and I don't judge people who have them even in like, I don't know, your
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:30.740
    | text      = face or your hands.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:33.019
    | text      = Very visible places.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:34.899
    | text      = I don't judge, but I realized that I did have some internalized judgment.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:39.300
    | text      = And it came to, all right, am I going to do this myself?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:43.019
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:44.019
    | text      = I got you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:45.019
    | text      = And I had to confront that a tiny bit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:47.300
    | text      = But yeah, worked through it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:49.220
    | text      = I got a spell from the game Eternal Darkness.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:52.420
    | text      = Nice.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:53.420
    | text      = One of my old favorite games.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:54.819
    | text      = I like it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:04:55.819
    | text      = Some real fond memories of getting stoned and hanging out with Nikki gifts and getting
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:00.680
    | text      = scared of video games.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:02.980
    | text      = That is what tattoos are for.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:04.819
    | text      = I swear to God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:06.420
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:07.579
    | text      = Yeah, it's a magic spell for a spell called the Magic Pool.

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:40.220
    | text      = One of the things that I think is pretty fascinating is that Alex is describing his magical abilities

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:55.160
    | text      = He can spell any word if he's just on autopilot, but if he's asked to spell anything, he's

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:01.099

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = can do magic, but if you confront him and demand that he tell you what's going to happen

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:25:12.220
    | text      = He can't do it on command.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:15.059
    | text      = This is a very old conman trick, and it has worked pretty well historically because it
}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = has a built-in excuse for why the trick didn't work.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:22.940
    | text      = The conman isn't really in control of their own magical gifts, and any attempt that they

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:34.539
    | text      = The other place you see this kind of thing is in adolescence.

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:50.579

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:59.359
    | text      = Kids tell each other shit like this all the time, and I don't want to deprive them of

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:18.219
    | text      = He formed his own production company, Full Vision Productions.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:21.780

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:27.659
    | text      = about yourself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:28.659
    | text      = I come from a commercial music video background.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:31.820
    | text      = I've done a lot of extreme sports, and now into the documentary filmmaking avenue.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:40.099
    | text      = So when you first got into TV, what did you do?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:42.179
    | text      = When I first got into TV, I was basically a temp.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:47.280
    | text      = I walked on the Disney lot.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:49.099
    | text      = I had no job whatsoever.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:51.380
    | text      = I walked into a building and they go, are you the temp?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:53.579
    | text      = And of course I said yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:51:55.739
    | text      = And I worked there, worked my way up, became a junior production executive, worked under
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:11.099
    | text      = So I left.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:12.139
    | text      = Absolutely not.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = In 2006, and entirely sane, people could find themselves on Info Wars, so I want to be careful
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = That said, it's important for Alex to present him as a very important filmmaker, because

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:36.820
    | text      = Which I think he could have taken the note a little differently.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:38.500
    | text      = Yeah, I mean artless isn't really a great note though.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:41.699
    | text      = I mean, so it's artless?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:44.260
    | text      = What does that mean?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:45.940
    | text      = Bad.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:46.940
    | text      = Should I cut more?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:50.099
    | text      = Was the storyboarding bad?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:54.019
    | text      = It's an umbrella thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:55.420
    | text      = That's what I'm saying.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:56.420
    | text      = You got no craft here, buddy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:57.980
    | text      = What does that even mean?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:58.980
    | text      = I don't have any craft?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:00.099
    | text      = Maybe I should just not make documentaries, is that what you're trying to say?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:03.019
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:04.019
    | text      = Oh shit, god damn that does sound right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:05.659
    | text      = Are you the temp?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:08.659
    | text      = We need someone to get coffee for the people at South by Southwest.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:11.099
    | text      = Okay fine, I'll get it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:12.300
    | text      = Sorry for giving you my film.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:14.059
    | text      = So he talks a little bit about this film with Alex.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:18.260
    | text      = Now you're making independent films, tell us about this new documentary you've made,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:22.860
    | text      = Prescription Suicide.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:25.179
    | text      = Prescription Suicide is a look into the families affected by anti-depressant drugs.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:31.019
    | text      = And basically what it is, it's six stories of six kids told by the families.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:36.900
    | text      = It's through their eyes, through their experiences, and there's no experts, there's no doctors
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:43.820
    | text      = telling you facts, it's just the families telling you what happened in their lives.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:48.659
    | text      = Oh that does sound artless.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:50.619
    | text      = So you're personalizing it?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:52.219
    | text      = Absolutely, it's a very personal approach.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:54.739
    | text      = It's great, and I think that personalizing mental illness stories can be often pretty
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:59.500
    | text      = helpful, but I think that there's huge problems with Robert's approach.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:03.599
    | text      = The first is that he's doing a documentary that's wildly critical of prescription drugs,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:07.739
    | text      = and he has no interest in hearing from the pro-medication interview subjects.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:12.139
    | text      = Like someone who can give voice to the other side, not interested, just leave it alone.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:16.500
    | text      = Let him out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:17.500
    | text      = This means that he's not setting out to do a piece that actually gets into medication
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:21.179
    | text      = and whether or not it's helpful.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:23.900
    | text      = Instead it's just meant to be a slice of life kind of thing looking at people who have
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:27.139
    | text      = had tragedies in their family that revolve around mental health.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:31.420
    | text      = The second problem is that he can't interview the people who died from suicide.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:36.260
    | text      = He can only hear their perspective through the lens of the family members who were alive.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:40.980
    | text      = I'm not saying that the family members don't have a valid story to tell or that their experience
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:45.699
    | text      = isn't important, but I'm saying that they don't know everything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:49.579
    | text      = It's a harsh reality that for a lot of people struggling with mental health issues, their
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:53.480
    | text      = family members can often be a part of why they're struggling.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:57.800
    | text      = Parental abuse or neglect can often be a big factor, and even when that isn't the case,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:02.800
    | text      = family members are often in complete denial about what someone is going through.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:07.639
    | text      = These interviews can provide a humanizing glimpse into what the family members thought
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:11.440
    | text      = was going on with their loved one, but it can't capture what they actually were going
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:15.920
    | text      = through.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:16.920
    | text      = Externally, it might have appeared to a mother that their child was getting worse after being
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:21.119
    | text      = on a prescription, but the documentary isn't about that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:24.639
    | text      = It's about blaming medications for people committing suicide.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:28.239
    | text      = This documentary is flawed in concept and from an execution standpoint.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:33.119
    | text      = It sounds artless.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:34.119
    | text      = It does sound very artless.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:36.000
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:37.000
    | text      = That's no good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:38.000
    | text      = That's no good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:39.000
    | text      = He later clarifies that there are six families, three with people who have died of suicide
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:46.800
    | text      = and three who attempted suicide.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:50.119
    | text      = And again, I was not able to watch this, so I don't know, but one of the people that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:59:57.400
    | text      = he is discussing, he does name this person, and I was able to look up their story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:00:06.320
    | text      = They ended up suing Paxil, the company that makes Paxil, and in the course of the lawsuit,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:00:12.360
    | text      = if you read the description of what happened, this person was on a bunch of drugs.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:00:19.000
    | text      = They were on PCP and had amphetamines in their system.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:00:23.139
    | text      = It was not just a situation where they were doing Paxil.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:00:28.400
    | text      = There's a lot of, I would say, confounding variables with some of the cases that they're
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:00:34.840
    | text      = talking about.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:00:37.599
    | text      = Based on their interview, I don't think they handle it well.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:00:39.719
    | text      = I can't imagine they do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:00:41.119
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:00:42.119
    | text      = The problem with anecdotal stories, for mental illness especially, is sooner or later you're
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:00:48.599
    | text      = going to be in there with the doctor and the doctor's going to give you an anecdote.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:00:52.840
    | text      = It's like, how do you deal with that?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:00:56.199
    | text      = Because the reality is, most of the time they work, but nothing works all the time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:02.599
    | text      = When you're dealing with the brain, that shit's crazy, so anything might get rewired somewhere.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:08.360
    | text      = Every time, the doctor is not trying to rewire you in the wrong place, but who fucking knows?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:14.079
    | text      = There's always going to be the most tragic story of a person who is fucking doomed, and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:20.119
    | text      = then the horrible things that happen because people exploit it, or don't do it correctly
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:25.480
    | text      = in response.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:27.480
    | text      = The stories, it's kind of tragic, but the stories of people who respond well to medication
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:35.239
    | text      = and go back to their lives and maybe have their lives saved by clinical and therapy
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:42.019
    | text      = approach to mental health crises, that's kind of not interesting to people in a documentary.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:51.340
    | text      = It's kind of a boring story that I got my life back together.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:54.579
    | text      = The interesting part of the story is probably before you got help.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:58.780
    | text      = It's way before.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:01:59.780
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:00.780
    | text      = Generally, that's why it's very interesting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:03.599
    | text      = These human interest stories and these humanizing things, I think they're valuable, and it's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:10.179
    | text      = not wrong to do this, but to use that in a way as a cudgel against this branch of mental
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:19.019
    | text      = health, I think is wrong.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:20.739
    | text      = I think you've correctly identified one of the main problems, which is that at the end
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:26.019
    | text      = of the day, pulling back, the goal of any mental health intervention is to make your
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:31.780
    | text      = life more boring.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:34.139
    | text      = That is the goal.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:35.619
    | text      = The goal is for you to have fewer interesting stories to tell.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:39.099
    | text      = Yeah, in a way.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:40.099
    | text      = Exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:41.099
    | text      = In a way.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:42.099
    | text      = But I think-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:43.099
    | text      = It's preferable because there are so many interesting stories that are interesting to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:46.179
    | text      = you that are not interesting to other people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:48.380
    | text      = It's very interesting to me whenever I go and just have dinner with my wife.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:52.179
    | text      = That is not a big story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:54.300
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:55.300
    | text      = There's another guest there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:57.300
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:58.300
    | text      = It's a lady who wrote a book, and so Alex introduces her.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:01.420
    | text      = We also have somebody here with us riding shotgun today, and that's Gwen Olsen, conducting
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:06.260
    | text      = confessions of an RX drug pusher, and God's call to loving arms.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:11.579
    | text      = And she's been on the inside, and then had already gotten disillusioned, gotten out of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:16.179
    | text      = the system, and then, even after she'd already gotten out of the system, then her niece died
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:20.659
    | text      = a just horrific death like so many others that have taken this drug.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:26.059
    | text      = And then we learned that even in the testing of the drugs, it came out that they knew it
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:30.780
    | text      = radically increased suicidal tendencies.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:33.219
    | text      = They knew it radically increased suicidal tendencies.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:36.860
    | text      = The opposite.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:37.860
    | text      = So we'll tell that story and talk about her book.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:40.059
    | text      = So Gwen Olsen wrote a book called Confessions of a Prescription Drug Pusher, God's Call
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:44.739
    | text      = to Loving Arms.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:45.739
    | text      = Oh boy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:46.739
    | text      = Which is something of a mind fuck in title form.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:49.579
    | text      = Her claim to fame was that she was a pharmaceutical rep who got disillusioned with the fact that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:53.559
    | text      = her job was to try to convince doctors to prescribe drugs more.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:57.539
    | text      = She came to view her job as being a drug pusher, and that's all good and well.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:04:01.440
    | text      = But things get confusing as the part where God is in the subtitle.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:04:04.760
    | text      = Yeah, that's a problem.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:04:06.239
    | text      = It makes total sense that someone would be a pharmaceutical rep and get disgusted with
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:04:09.920
    | text      = the whole industry of over-prescribing drugs and come out with a tell-all book.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:04:14.500
    | text      = That makes sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:04:16.199
    | text      = It's a valid angle to attack Big Pharma from, and it represents an actual problem that we
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:04:20.820
    | text      = could work on solving.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:04:22.719
    | text      = The God part is a departure though, and it raises alarms.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:04:27.300
    | text      = So I read through most of Gwen's book, and it's basically a memoir that's been co-opted
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:04:32.219
    | text      = into an anti-medication tome.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:04:34.980
    | text      = I think that she's a willing participant in that co-option, but the core of what that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:04:39.519
    | text      = book is about could have gone a different direction.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:04:42.300
    | text      = Essentially, she's a person with a very tumultuous family history, full of abuse and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:04:47.059
    | text      = chaos.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:04:48.300
    | text      = People in her family have not had good outcomes with psychiatric drugs, which she is universalized
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:04:53.179
    | text      = into a belief that these drugs don't work.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:04:55.500
    | text      = There we go.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:04:56.500
    | text      = So she seems to take issue with what she thinks is a universal belief that mental illnesses
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:05:00.900
    | text      = are passed on genetically, which gives credence to the idea that the solution to them should
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:05:05.579
    | text      = be drugs.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:05:06.960
    | text      = Her family shared some mental health struggles, but her take on it is that it's not a genetic
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:05:11.619
    | text      = condition, it's a spiritual sickness.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:05:14.739
    | text      = I don't really take much issue with that as a basic perspective, and my whole life has
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:05:19.219
    | text      = been in conversation with mental health issues.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:05:21.980
    | text      = I've met people, including fellow mentally unwell people as well as doctors, and some
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:05:26.940
    | text      = of them think medication is more important than other approaches, and others don't.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:05:32.119
    | text      = Some think that medication is right for them, and others swear by it, some people think
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:05:36.300
    | text      = I don't really want to mess with that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:05:38.719
    | text      = But everyone I've ever dealt with understands that there's a role for multiple approaches.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:05:44.420
    | text      = I've never known anyone who thought a pill was a magic solution, but I do understand
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:05:49.300
    | text      = that that thinking did exist in the past.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:05:52.980
    | text      = What perpetuated that kind of thinking was mostly marketing, where a company would try
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:05:56.599
    | text      = to brand their new pill as a miracle drug, right up to the extent that the law would
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:00.940
    | text      = allow them to.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:02.860
    | text      = Gwen worked in that machine.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:04.639
    | text      = Her job as a pharmaceutical rep was to be the salesperson for these drugs.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:09.780
    | text      = A different department was in charge of making the ads, but she was the part of the business
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:13.860
    | text      = that was on the ground, asking the doctors, what can I put you down for?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:18.699
    | text      = It makes total sense that existing in that world would make you think that the whole
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:22.500
    | text      = mental health approach in the country was based on pushing drugs, so I kind of don't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:27.380
    | text      = judge Gwen too harshly for having that perspective.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:31.139
    | text      = What she's presenting as the universal position isn't the universal position, but it probably
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:37.059
    | text      = felt that way to her, so I can see how that, like, her coming from that place is sincere.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:43.659
    | text      = Yeah, when I was doing hearing aids, I was, I've done it in, like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:48.820
    | text      = general clinical areas where you've got an ophthalmologist and you've got all that stuff, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:06:53.539
    | text      = And so I've seen so many drug reps buy so many lunches, and it is disillusioning.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:01.820
    | text      = Don't get me wrong, there is no way to see one of those people walk in with, like, mediocre
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:06.679
    | text      = Chinese food catered and then realize that they're selling, like, OxyContin by the bucket load.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:12.699
    | text      = But I don't know, what else are you gonna do?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:14.980
    | text      = Somebody's gotta go.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:16.079
    | text      = I'm not gonna ever argue that there is a major problem, and has been for a long time, with
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:23.320
    | text      = this structure of pharma as a business.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:26.639
    | text      = Yeah, but I mean, once you start with, like, oh, the medical industry's fucked as a business,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:31.199
    | text      = everybody agrees with you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:33.159
    | text      = And so is everything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:34.159
    | text      = Exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:35.159
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:36.159
    | text      = Business is fucked as a business.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:37.159
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:38.159
    | text      = When things like medications and shit have, like, gigantic financial incentives attached
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:44.280
    | text      = to them and shareholders and all this shit, it becomes very messy, and I think that's unhealthy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:49.679
    | text      = Yeah, insulin's free to make and it costs some amount of money that's ungodly, so...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:54.039
    | text      = It's bullshit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:55.039
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:07:56.039
    | text      = So this book is generally, it seems like the story of a person who discovered that non-medication
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:00.039
    | text      = approaches to dealing with mental illness and trauma existed, and thinking that no one
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:04.900
    | text      = had ever heard of them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:06.320
    | text      = That seems to be what her journey is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:08.940
    | text      = She worked as a pharmaceutical rep, so she probably wasn't exposed to as many people
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:12.719
    | text      = promoting yoga or meditation, which is being experienced as someone, like, was trying to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:17.699
    | text      = cover these things up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:19.520
    | text      = And that just is silly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:21.800
    | text      = It's all great to promote these kinds of things and taking a holistic approach to mental health,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:26.020
    | text      = but if I'm being fair, that is not where this book stops.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:29.439
    | text      = I agree with her on a very basic premise that she's making about this idea that medication
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:34.840
    | text      = isn't, it's not gonna solve all your problems.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:37.159
    | text      = Sure, sure, sure, sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:38.159
    | text      = Her argument expands to being anti-medication in a way that her story does not earn.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:43.399
    | text      = I resent this book, and I think her approach and the impact of that book has done far more
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:48.119
    | text      = damage to people's mental health than anything she did as a pharmaceutical rep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:51.800
    | text      = And I'm just gonna say this off the bat, that I'm not gonna cover too much about what Gwen
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:08:55.579
    | text      = talks about on the show, because a lot of it is about her niece who died from suicide,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:00.520
    | text      = and that's very uncomfortable.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:02.880
    | text      = The niece was struggling with mental illness and drug abuse, and her mom was trying to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:06.680
    | text      = get her help, which Gwen didn't approve of because it involved medication.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:11.039
    | text      = Gwen decided that all of her niece's symptoms were actually being caused by the medications,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:15.199
    | text      = and seemingly appointed herself as the niece's guardian, and positioned herself as the enemy
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:19.859
    | text      = of her niece's mom, her sister.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:22.960
    | text      = It's honestly all very fucked up, and it's painfully obvious that Gwen projected a lot
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:26.840
    | text      = of her baggage onto the niece in a way that was entirely unfair and probably exacerbated
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:31.760
    | text      = what was already a horrible situation that she was in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:35.880
    | text      = I read the story in Gwen's own words in her book, and I think an argument could be made
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:41.279
    | text      = that she's partially responsible for her niece's death.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:44.500
    | text      = That would explain a lot of people's very vehement views if you think about it for
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:49.760
    | text      = five seconds and go, well, you can either have that vehement view or recognize that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:53.880
    | text      = you might be partially responsible for a lot of terrible shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:57.399
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:58.399
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:59.399
    | text      = Some people might think that that's taking it too far, so I'll just make a very safe
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:02.479
    | text      = statement, which is that she's exploiting her niece's death, and I find it disgusting,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:06.880
    | text      = and that is what a lot of her interview is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:09.680
    | text      = So I'm not engaging.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:13.720
    | text      = It is strange to have the experience.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:19.119
    | text      = My memoir, the memoir that did it for me, so to speak, was by Dr. K. Redfield Jamison.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:25.600
    | text      = It's called An Unquiet Mind, and it's one of my favorite books anybody's ever written,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:29.560
    | text      = and it is about somebody who is a doctor in the field who has bipolar type one, the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:35.560
    | text      = classic double whammy, somebody who's on both sides, as opposed to somebody who's a pharmaceutical
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:41.439
    | text      = rep, and that is just not the space to be in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:45.119
    | text      = Yeah, and I don't want to say that she's stupid by any means.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:49.319
    | text      = No, it has nothing to do with intelligence as we consider it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:53.279
    | text      = Well, there's a but coming.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:54.279
    | text      = Well.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:55.279
    | text      = I do think it's dumb the way that she presents herself as if she's a doctor in the book.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:01.079
    | text      = She presents a lot of, oh, I mean, I was selling these drugs to doctors, so I had to learn
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:06.899
    | text      = a lot about them, just like a doctor, and that's not really true, and it comes off really,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:14.039
    | text      = really bad, and I think that there's an extent to, I'm kind of trying to be gracious and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:23.460
    | text      = nice by not covering her interview, because I think I'd have really fucking horrible things
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:28.840
    | text      = to say if I did, and let's not dwell on that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:32.340
    | text      = Yeah, it's tough, because it's like your clinical experience is talking to doctors.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:39.779
    | text      = Doctors' clinical experience is talking to people, and so you can't have the same point
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:45.199
    | text      = of view on efficacy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:46.699
    | text      = Yeah, yeah, and your job is sales.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:49.859
    | text      = Exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:50.859
    | text      = Not medicine.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:51.899
    | text      = Beautiful job of medicine.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:53.500
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:54.500
    | text      = So Alex talks a little bit about Prozac and how it is ...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:58.779
    | text      = Is great and really ... Oh, nope.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:00.300
    | text      = Very bad.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:01.300
    | text      = Unsurprising.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:02.300
    | text      = In fact, let me ask you this, Gwen.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:03.539
    | text      = Back in the early 80s when they approved Prozac, it's admitted now, and this actually came
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:08.060
    | text      = out a long time ago, right around that time that you were working for them, but it was
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:11.140
    | text      = in a few publications, but not really publicly widely circulated, that they knew it radically
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:16.420
    | text      = increased suicide around 15%, which is a huge increase, and was actually a suicide
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:21.819
    | text      = drug.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:22.819
    | text      = I mean, it really encouraged it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:24.619
    | text      = That was one of the main effects.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:25.619
    | text      = And then here they are pushing it for depression.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:28.180
    | text      = Did you ever hear that when you were in the industry?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:29.739
    | text      = Did you ever hear anybody criticize?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:32.060
    | text      = Absolutely not.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:33.060
    | text      = In fact, I only heard all of the positive information.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:35.859
    | text      = The drugs were non-addicting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:37.619
    | text      = The drugs were benign.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:38.859
    | text      = The drugs were not neurotoxic, all of that sort of thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:42.579
    | text      = There's literally no reason why anyone in the pharmaceutical industry would be telling
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:46.520
    | text      = Gwen to say any of that stuff about their products.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:49.300
    | text      = None of it's true.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:50.819
    | text      = So it would be entirely counterproductive for them to say, like, oh, our product is
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:55.460
    | text      = neurotoxic, or whatever.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:57.579
    | text      = That would be crazy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:58.579
    | text      = Silly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:59.579
    | text      = It would be crazy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:00.579
    | text      = I'm not saying that pharmaceutical industry reps don't ever mislead people about their
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:03.300
    | text      = drugs, just that it's not a lie to say that antidepressants aren't neurotoxic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:08.640
    | text      = So there's a lot of studies about antidepressants like Prozac and whether or not they make things
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:12.260
    | text      = like suicidal ideation worse.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:15.260
    | text      = Most of it shows no evidence that they cause any increase, but there are some studies that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:19.020
    | text      = suggest that they might.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:20.939
    | text      = Because of that, and because drug companies are very averse to getting sued, almost all
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:25.500
    | text      = medications prescribed for mood disorders have added a warning that say that they could
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:29.619
    | text      = cause an increase in suicidal ideation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:32.899
    | text      = This is less a reflection of a real risk that these medications pose, and more of a way
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:37.039
    | text      = for drug companies to handle responsibility and spread it out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:43.079
    | text      = If you do a study about people who have depression with notable suicidal ideation, and you treat
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:48.539
    | text      = one group with Prozac and another group with a placebo, what outcome might you expect?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:55.119
    | text      = Certainly with Alex's belief system, he would expect a higher incidence of suicidal ideation
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:59.300
    | text      = in the Prozac group after treatment, because he thinks that the drug causes that, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:04.159
    | text      = That makes sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:05.159
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:06.279
    | text      = The problem is that even if you had a study like that, and those were the results you
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:10.119
    | text      = got, it would be very hard to untangle all the confounding variables.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:15.000
    | text      = You'd have a result that was worth discussing and retesting and looking more into, but you
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:19.520
    | text      = wouldn't have proven anything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:21.560
    | text      = A 2013 paper published in the Journal of Psychological Research hoped to find a way to get rid of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:26.699
    | text      = some of the more serious confounding variables, primarily how severe depression can be hard
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:33.960
    | text      = to identify how much of the symptoms are caused by the condition compared to the treatment.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:39.319
    | text      = An ideal situation would be to treat non-depressed people with Prozac and see if they got depressed
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:43.840
    | text      = or suicidal, but that study wasn't available and no one's going to do that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:48.039
    | text      = Something kinda close was, though.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:50.760
    | text      = A 2004 outpatient study was done with patients suffering from minor depression who had much
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:56.079
    | text      = lower rates of suicidal ideation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:58.840
    | text      = These patients were split into double-blind groups, one being treated with Prozac and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:02.680
    | text      = the other with a placebo, and they were checked up on for 12 weeks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:06.720
    | text      = Basically, they had those questionnaires that you get and they ask you about your suicidal
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:11.640
    | text      = ideation rated on a scale of 0 to 4.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:15.119
    | text      = This paper analyzed the rates that people in the Prozac and placebo groups had increases
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:19.800
    | text      = of one or two points.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:22.060
    | text      = They found that people in the placebo group had higher rates of increased suicidal ideation,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:28.020
    | text      = but the amount was statistically insignificant.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:31.439
    | text      = However, there was a wrinkle.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:33.920
    | text      = There was no statistical significance in the difference in groups in terms of who had an
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:38.840
    | text      = increase of one or two points, but if you only included the people who had baseline
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:43.920
